items.title: The Plan You Chose
items.why:
Nothing is built yet. These are mock-ups in the app's own style.

What you picked: backup history comes with Cloud Sync, keeps 90 days, and a restore asks Merge or Replace.

How it will work: once a day, when something has changed, the phone sends one locked copy of the profile to your Cloudflare R2 storage. It is locked with the same key as sync, so Cloudflare cannot read it. The newest 90 are kept; older ones are removed only when a new one arrives, so a long break never empties the list. Deleting the cloud copy also deletes the history.

Cost: free at your size. R2 includes 10 GB a month free (Cloudflare's R2 pricing page, read today); two accounts with 90 days each should stay well under 1 GB.

items.title: Where Backup History Lives
items.why: It only shows when the profile is signed in to sync.

options.label: A · A button in Cloud Sync
options.desc: One more button in the card that's already there. Nothing new to read.

options.label: B · Its own card
options.desc: A separate card under Cloud Sync that says when the last copy was saved and what it's for.

items.title: The List of Days
items.why: Tapping opens this list. Pick a day to restore it.

options.label: A · Day and number of entries
options.desc: The count helps you spot the day before something went missing.

options.label: B · Day only
options.desc: Shorter rows, nothing but the date and time.

items.title: Before a Restore
items.why: Picking a day shows this. It uses the same Merge and Replace as importing a backup file, and Goku saves a copy of right now first so a restore can be undone.
